name: todox
description: The log your next session resumes from: decisions, dead ends, handoffs and open tasks, shared across machines, agents and people over the todox MCP server. Briefs a session with the log at start, and asks once for its handoff before it finishes.

token.title: todox agent token (optional)
token.description: Leave empty: the todox tools sign in through your browser the first time (/mcp → todox → Authenticate), and the hooks use the token `npx https://github.com/beydemirfurkan/todox/releases/latest/download/todox-mcp.tgz login` saves. Only for a machine with no browser: a personal token from the Account page, starting with todox_. Stored in your Claude Code settings, never in this plugin.
